headline: The Mets put nearly $400 million in front of Skubal, and the rest of the pitching market is waiting on his answer.

news.title: Giants keep Doval for one year, trade Koss to the Rays
news.note: Doval avoided arbitration at a reported $6.3M after a 4.30 ERA between the Yankees and Pirates. Koss went to Tampa Bay for minor-league RHP Cole Stokes.

news.title: Mets reportedly offer Skubal nine years, almost $400M
news.note: Jim Duquette reported the offer; it would be the highest AAV ever for a free-agent starter. Skubal has met the Mets, Dodgers, Blue Jays, Padres and a fifth team over Zoom, and is expected to pick by Dec. 1.

news.title: Morosi: King and Peralta wait on Skubal; White Sox in on both
news.note: Morosi expects the next tier of starters to sign after Skubal. The Giants want Boyd or Pivetta, and the Mets are on Ty France.

news.title: Tigers extend Troy Melton six years, $46.5M
news.note: The deal can reach $98M with an option and incentives. Melton had a 2.76 ERA in 20 starts after moving to the rotation.

news.title: D-backs get Johan Oviedo from Boston
news.note: Arizona gave up minor-league LHP Luke Dotson plus a PTBNL or cash. Oviedo missed most of 2026 with an elbow sprain.

news.title: Union pitches international changes; MLB drops high school draft idea
news.note: The MLBPA wants to keep bonus pools, with soft caps and penalties for early deals, rather than an international draft. MLB dropped its plan to keep high schoolers out of the draft.
